mustFindings.requirement: Two decimals, leading minus sign for debits
Read and write 5,000 entries at a time

mustScenarios.risk: A five-cent debit is written as -0.05 and a 1,234.50 credit as 1234.50 (two decimals, sign only on debits)
Accounts with exactly 5,000 and 5,001 entries: every entry is exported once, none duplicated or skipped across the page boundary
An account with no entries returns only the CSV header
A database error after the first page leaves a truncated file with a 200 status, which finance could import as complete
Descriptions containing commas, quotes or newlines are escaped so columns stay aligned

forbidden.description: Excel or PDF exports and date-range filters are in neither the issue nor the code

notes: Narrative PRD with no extractable criteria. AC3 is unclear by design: a 30-second target for 100,000 entries cannot be judged from code. AC1 and AC2 are implemented.
